_comment: Reference copy. The live file is %LOCALAPPDATA%\ClaudeGovee\config.json, written with defaults on first run and hot-reloaded on save. Property names are case-insensitive.
_comment_gradient: Docs say 1 = gradient on; the DLL's internal field is named _gradientOffSkus, implying the opposite. Both return success, so flip this if segment blending looks wrong.
_comment_devices: Leave empty to drive every LAN-enabled device automatically. Segments is discovered from GetDeviceBaseInfo when 0 - do not trust device_info.ini, which reports a flat 10 for everything.
_comment_rest: The Govee API cannot read a device's current colour, so OnSessionEnd 'rest' means 'apply RestColor', not 'put back what was there'. Use 'off' if you care about a scene surviving.
_comment_states: Effects: solid, breathe, pulse, blink, chase, comet. Chase and comet need SegmentNums > 1 and fall back to breathe otherwise. Brightness -1 leaves it alone.
_comment_tools: Overrides only - the built-in map already covers the standard tools. Anything starting with mcp__ is classified as ToolMcp automatically.
